text:
The Kestrel planning meetings (3–10 November) set configuration, dependencies, and worker assignments for about 26 modules. Client requirements fix cache `retry_limit` at 3, catalog `retry_limit` at 8, and gateway `batch_size` at 250. Corrected values are cache `ttl_s` (360), upload `ttl_s` (570), `timeout_s` (85), and checkout `timeout_s` (75).

Ordering rules require gateway before auth, metrics before indexer, cache before audit, and checkout before returns. Audit/returns, catalog/ingest, and alerts/ledger run on separate workers.

Dependency limits: no path from metrics to catalog, auth cannot depend on catalog, gateway cannot depend on webhooks, and ingest cannot depend on pricing.

Open items include a month-end security review, a budget review moved to next Thursday, on-call rota changes next month, and Maya's leave next week.
